# Cldr Lists v2.12.2 - Table of Contents

List formatting functions for the Common Locale Data Repository (CLDR)
package ex_cldr.

## Pages

- [Cldr for Lists](https://ex-cldr-lists.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://ex-cldr-lists.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LICENSE](https://ex-cldr-lists.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Cldr.List](https://ex-cldr-lists.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.List.md): Cldr module to formats lists.
- [Cldr.List.Backend](https://ex-cldr-lists.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.List.Backend.md)
- [Cldr.List.Pattern](https://ex-cldr-lists.hexdocs.pm/Cldr.List.Pattern.md): A list pattern drives list formatting and it defines how to combine
list elements at the beggining, in the middle and at the end of
a list. It also has a special pattern used when the list contains
only two elements.
